text:
Priya: Quick idea — we should expose per_call_effective_cost in /v1/metrics so the Console can show net cost per invocation (includes cache savings + batching amortization). Current dashboard mixes token-level and cache credits and people get confused :eyes:

Priya: Proposal: API returns both gross_token_cost_usd and net_token_cost_usd plus a small breakdown: billed_tokens, cached_tokens, cache_savings_usd, batching_savings_usd, per_call_effective_cost_usd.

Marco: Sounds reasonable. How do we compute batching_savings_usd? If we estimate from observed batch sizes we need to expose sample_rate and a confidence interval — sampling noise will bite us.

Liya: +1 on exposing both gross/net. UX suggestion: show a tiny "why this number" tooltip with formula and sampling metadata. Without that folks will assume it's exact.

Sam: One API-compatibility concern — rather than changing the default response shape, add an opt-in query param like ?include_cost_breakdown=true so older clients don't break.

Priya: For rollout: enable for 10% tenants with the param enabled in Console and surface a banner that values are estimated when sample_rate < 1. Also need to cap storage: rollup per-minute and only keep raw per-invocation rows for 24h.

Marco: Attribution question: do we credit cache savings to the route or to the model? With sticky routing it can cross routes and confuse chargebacks.

Priya: My suggestion: use a documented "first-owner-on-prefix" heuristic — credit the route that first served the prefix that produced the cached KV. If we later re-route, first-owner keeps the credit. We'll call it out in docs.

ops-bot: DB migration scheduled: add columns feature_metrics.cache_savings_usd, batching_savings_usd, per_call_effective_cost_usd on 2026-03-24T02:00Z (migration id: 20260324_02). Canary will receive migration first.

Sam: Example API response (opt-in):
```json
{
  "total_tokens": 247,
  "billed_tokens": 160,
  "cached_tokens": 87,
  "gross_token_cost_usd": "0.0123",
  "cache_savings_usd": "0.0068",
  "batching_savings_usd": "0.0015",
  "per_call_effective_cost_usd": "0.0040",
  "sample_rate": 0.05,
  "confidence_90": 0.0008
}
```

Liya: UI copy idea: "Net cost per call (after cache & batching)" with hover explainer that expands the JSON fields and shows the formula. Also add a toggle to switch between gross/net in billing exports.

Priya: Action items: Sam to draft API PR + migration, Marco to write sampling math and CI calcs, Liya to mock tooltip + toggle, and I'll write the docs for first-owner attribution. Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> opt-in GA.

Marco: Also propose a Console-level flag to "show estimated values" that can be disabled for strict billing views (so finance sees only gross billed tokens).

Priya: Great — thanks. Sync in eng-platform tomorrow.

Marco: :thumbsup:

Liya: I'll drop a quick mock in Figma after stand.

Sam: Will open the PR by EOD and tag everyone.
